source_js: const visual = { prepare: function (input) { return [{kind:'text',payload:'F(x)=F₀(1−x/h)'},{kind:'text',payload:'F(x)'},{kind:'text',payload:'x'},{kind:'text',payload:'0'},{kind:'text',payload:'h/2'},{kind:'text',payload:'h'},{kind:'text',payload:'F₀'},{kind:'text',payload:'W/(F₀h)=3/8=0.375'},{kind:'text',payload:'阴影面积 W = 3/8 F₀h'},{kind:'text',payload:'0 ≤ x ≤ h'}]; }, render: function (input, metrics) { var W = (input.viewport && input.viewport.widthDu) || 720; var H = (input.viewport && input.viewport.heightDu) || 460; var m = {left: 80, right: 46, top: 46, bottom: 64}; var plotW = Math.max(10, W - m.left - m.right); var plotH = Math.max(10, H - m.top - m.bottom); var ox = m.left; var oy = H - m.bottom; var xh = ox + plotW; var yTop = m.top; function px(t) { return ox + t * plotW; } function py(v) { return oy - v * plotH; } var p00 = [px(0), py(0)]; var p0F = [px(0), py(1)]; var pMid = [px(0.5), py(0.5)]; var pMid0 = [px(0.5), py(0)]; var pEnd0 = [px(1), py(0)]; var paths = []; var root = {type:'group', children: []}; function addPath(id, commands, stroke, fill, dash) { paths.push({id:id, commands:commands}); var node = {type:'path', pathId:id}; if (stroke) node.stroke = stroke; if (fill) node.fill = fill; if (dash) node.strokeDasharray = dash; root.children.push(node); } function addLabel(x,y,text,size,anchor,fill) { root.children.push({type:'label', x:x, y:y, text:text, fontSize:size || 14, textAnchor:anchor || 'start', fill:fill || '#1f2a44'}); } addPath('shade', visualSdk.polyline([p00, p0F, pMid, pMid0, p00]), 'none', '#bcd7ff'); addPath('guide', visualSdk.polyline([pMid0, pMid]), '#5a6d8a', 'none', '5 5'); addPath('xaxis', visualSdk.arrow(ox, oy, W - 26, oy, {}), '#26354a', 'none'); addPath('yaxis', visualSdk.arrow(ox, oy, ox, 22, {}), '#26354a', 'none'); addPath('curve', visualSdk.polyline([p0F, pEnd0]), '#c2410c', 'none'); addPath('tick0', visualSdk.polyline([[ox, oy - 5], [ox, oy + 5]]), '#26354a', 'none'); addPath('tickMid', visualSdk.polyline([[px(0.5), oy - 5], [px(0.5), oy + 5]]), '#26354a', 'none'); addPath('tickH', visualSdk.polyline([[xh, oy - 5], [xh, oy + 5]]), '#26354a', 'none'); addPath('tickF0', visualSdk.polyline([[ox - 5, py(1)], [ox + 5, py(1)]]), '#26354a', 'none'); addLabel(ox + 18, 30, 'F(x)=F₀(1−x/h)', 17, 'start', '#1f2a44'); addLabel(ox - 12, yTop - 8, 'F(x)', 15, 'end', '#26354a'); addLabel(W - 26, oy + 22, 'x', 15, 'end', '#26354a'); addLabel(ox - 5, oy + 20, '0', 13, 'end', '#26354a'); addLabel(px(0.5), oy + 20, 'h/2', 13, 'middle', '#26354a'); addLabel(xh, oy + 20, 'h', 13, 'middle', '#26354a'); addLabel(ox - 10, py(1) + 5, 'F₀', 14, 'end', '#26354a'); addLabel(px(0.07), py(0.78), '阴影面积 W = 3/8 F₀h', 14, 'start', '#1d4ed8'); addLabel(px(0.56), py(0.86), 'W/(F₀h)=3/8=0.375', 15, 'start', '#1d4ed8'); addLabel(px(0.5), H - 22, '0 ≤ x ≤ h', 14, 'middle', '#26354a'); return {schemaVersion:1, sceneId:'f-x-plot', revision: input.revision, viewBox:{x:0,y:0,width:W,height:H}, paths:paths, root:root}; } };
